heroIntro: Hi there! I'm yazarts! A self-taught digital artist based in [your city].
bio:
I'm a self-taught digital artist. I started out drawing just for fun, filling sketchbooks with characters from the stories I loved, and slowly taught myself digital painting one tutorial, one mistake and one late night at a time.

These days I mostly paint characters: original characters, fan art and portraits, with soft light, rich colour and a little bit of mood. I love giving a character a feeling you can sense before you even know their story.

I also take commissions, so you can have your own character or OC drawn in my style. Every piece is made with care, from the first rough sketch to the final details.

You can follow my work and process on Instagram, TikTok and Reddit, and if you'd like to support what I do, you can find me on Ko-fi. Thank you for stopping by!
